principle: The first release must remain operable with Docker Compose + Caddy alone. External services are optional adapters admitted only when they reduce operator friction or improve reliability without becoming a second deployment authority.

requirements: public DNS resolves to the host

registry.admission_rule: publish only accepted exact-main artifacts with immutable SHA metadata

dns_proxy.ownership: external DNS/proxy only; must not replace Caddy/application runtime authority

uptime_monitoring.admission_rule: prefer low-cost/free service only after an operator needs external availability notification

error_monitoring.admission_rule: enable when production incident evidence shows application exception aggregation is needed

analytics.privacy_rule: product analytics is independent of operational health and must remain opt-in

object_storage.admission_rule: introduce when media/blob growth proves local or database storage is operationally inappropriate

anti_lock_in_rule: A convenience control panel or SaaS integration may wrap the supported production contract but must not become the only way to deploy, recover or inspect SongChart.
